name: thurbox-voice
description: Dictation support for Thurbox, using local models
install:
git clone https://github.com/TMSCH/thurbox-voice && cd thurbox-voice
cargo install --locked --path crates/thurbox-voice
thurbox-voice pull parakeet
thurbox-cli mod install git+https://github.com/TMSCH/thurbox-voice
thurbox-cli mod check
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.56.0, Rust and cmake; Linux also needs pkg-config and ALSA headers. Trust the voice pane to run its helper. Audio stays local. An optional cleanup pass, on by default, sends the transcript and session context to a language model, hosted unless you point it at a local server. See README.

name: thurbox-annotate
description: Review a coding agent's output inside thurbox and send it numbered feedback — herdr-annotate, wired into thurbox's own panes.
platforms: Windows / WSL (Lite clipboard support; Full requires POSIX scripts)
notes: Shown command installs Lite; requires Thurbox ≥ 2.25.0. Grant run for agent clipboard selection. Full uses plannotator-tui and the program capability; see README for its installer. F2 opens Lite; GIF shows Full.

name: thurbox-files
description: A file column for thurbox v2: a tree of the session's working directory, its context menu, and the agent pane's editor and diff tabs
install:
thurbox-cli mod install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as mods/90_files.lua
thurbox-cli mod install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as mods/95_files_menu.lua
thurbox-cli mod install git+https://github.com/spscream/thurbox-files --as mods/20_agent.lua
platforms: Other platforms (POSIX tools and nvim required; unverified)
notes: Follow the README to replace the bundled agent pane, place the files slot in layout.lua and grant capabilities. Requires nvim. Conflicts with the code-review agent pane fork.

name: thurbox-fleetlens
description: Fleet Lens: browse Fleet v2 resources in a keyboard-first thurbox float
install:
thurbox-cli mod install git+https://github.com/Thurbeen/thurbox-fleetlens
thurbox-cli mod check
notes: Reads Fleet only through fleet … --json. Trust the pane to run fleet: Settings (Ctrl+,), then ], select thurbox-fleetlens/plugins/88_fleet_lens.lua and press t. Alt+K opens it. Read-only. The fleetlens settings choose the fleet binary, its config, and the host it runs on (POSIX only).

name: thurbox-info-panel
description: The info panel for thurbox v2: session, git, agent, usage and system readouts as a Lua pane
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.51.7. Add the info slot to layout.lua, then press F2. Account quotas need quota-axi ≥ 0.1.58 and a run grant; install the optional refresh extension from the cloned mod directory. See README for setup.

name: thurbox-code-review
description: A code-review pane for thurbox v2: the diff of a session's worktree against its base branch, reviewable in the TUI
platforms: Windows (Lua pane; optional shell commands need a POSIX shell)
notes: Requires Thurbox ≥ 2.35.0. Replaces the bundled agent pane; follow README setup and capability grants. Cannot combine with the thurbox-files agent pane fork.

name: thurbox-doom
description: DOOM as a thurbox v2 pane: a Lua plugin that frames a terminal DOOM port in a session surface
platforms: Other platforms (bring or build an engine)
notes: Install code-review for the integrated Doom tab, then grant its agent pane program. F5 opens Doom. GIF shows the earlier standalone pane; README documents current setup.

name: thurbox-auto-continue
description: Headless, LLM-free auto-continue extension for Claude sessions in Thurbox
notes: Requires cargo or a prebuilt binary, Claude Code and Thurbox ≥ 2.36.2. Off by default. Follow the README to install both optional panes and grant run. Native Windows unsupported.
